description: This file is a shell test script that verifies the behavior of the Git trace2 facility (normal target). It contains setup procedures, utility functions, and multiple test cases to check trace output, event sequences, error handling, configuration variables, and URL redaction behavior relevant to the trace2 feature in Git.

methods.name: scrub_normal
methods.description: A shell function that sanitizes trace2 output by replacing variable fields such as elapsed time and command arguments to make output comparison stable in tests.
